shortBulletSummary: Crypto Fear & Greed Index is at 13, reflecting "Extreme Fear" as Bitcoin hovers near $60,000, confirming a bearish trend.
Federal Reserve officials are indicating a possible 2026 interest rate hike due to sticky inflation, pushing "higher for longer" rate expectations.
Spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded significant outflows of $1.3 billion this past week, totaling over $4.4 billion in 13 days, indicating institutional caution.
US spot Ethereum ETFs have seen outflows for six to seven consecutive days, totaling $81.9 million on June 25 and $12.85 million on June 26, reflecting cooling demand.
Trump's potential refusal to sign the Clarity Act due to a housing bill issue could further delay crucial crypto market regulation.
